item.title: Can ‘American Idol’ Still Create an Instant Star?

item.title: Amy Klobuchar Slams Live Nation Settlement: ‘Every Sign Points to a Backroom Deal’

item.title: Travis Scott Tells Supreme Court Use of Rap Lyrics in Death Sentence Was Unconstitutional

item.title: Jack White Responds After Uproar Over Taylor Swift Songwriting Comment
